rows.grounds: locative plural of sahasra, expressing location within a large number
compound yoni+yantra in locative plural, denoting realms or devices of birth
past passive participle of √pīḍ, describing the state of beings

items.question: What condition afflicts beings within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms?
premises: Beings are situated within these womb-mechanisms.
These beings are subjected to torment.
items.inference: Existence within the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms entails a state of torment.
uncertainties: The subject experiencing torment is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
